description: box [0,0,0]–[10,10,10] ∪ box [10,10,0]–[20,20,10], touching along the edge x = 10, y = 10: two touching lumps, each with its own copy of the contact edge and its endpoints (ADR-0090)

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE returns two solids sharing the contact edge and endpoints. Arris returns one solid with a shell and separate contact topology for each lump.
analytic.occt_odd_euler: The two Open CASCADE solids share one edge and its endpoints.
analytic.occt_step_counts_differ: Open CASCADE writes the contact once per solid in STEP, with 16 vertices and 24 edges instead of 14 and 23 in memory.
